address: Imam Saud Bin Abdulaziz Bin Mohammed Road, King Fahd, Riyadh, 12274, Saudi Arabia
bio: Set within the King Fahd neighbourhood, not too far away from the bustling Financial District, is this Moroccan restaurant with its eye-catching décor. A feeling of warmth starts from the welcome to the interior design, and continues with the service. A sea of lampshades hang from the ceiling and authentic artefacts are strewn across a spacious room, creating an intimate setting, similar to that of a Moroccan home. The menu offers some hearty and flavoursome dishes, with the pastilla and tagine being particularly memorable.
